text:
mira: heads up — noticed a telemetry delta for some tenants after the v2 rollout. usage looks normal but costs reported in console jump for v1 clients that hit our routing fallback.
kevin: can you paste a sample request/headers?
mira: here are redacted headers from one tenant: `X-Client-Version: 1.3.4`, `Accept-Version: v1` and body param `prompt` (v1) vs v2 expecting `input`. backend logs show v1 got routed to v2-compatible model and cost calc used v2 token weights.
alex: that mismatch would explain quota/charge deltas. routing fallthrough currently maps by model family only, not param shape.
sam: so v1 requests that land on v2 path are being charged v2 unit rates? ouch.
julia: do we have a quick shim to translate `prompt`->`input` and also tag telemetry so we can measure how often fallback happens?
kevin: yes. simplest is gateway rewrite + metadata tag. e.g. in our edge proxy:
```
if request.headers['Accept-Version'] == 'v1' and 'prompt' in body:
  body['input'] = body.pop('prompt')
  request.headers['X-Compat-Map'] = 'v1->v2:prompt->input'
```
kevin: that will keep downstream code happy and produce a tag we can surface in the console.
ops: logs show ~230 tenants hit the fallback in the last 6h, mostly low-volume. posting sample logs: `tenant=acme corp fallback=true accept-version=v1 routed-to=v2 model=redwood-small`
mira: nice. couple of concerns: 1) telemetry name collisions (v1 metric names vs v2), 2) quota math — should we apply quota mapping or charge using the actual execution cost?
alex: for correctness we should charge actual execution cost (what the runtime consumed). but we need to surface a mapped quota in UI so tenants on v1 don't see sudden spikes. suggestion: keep billing accurate, but add an explanation + "mapped quota view" in console showing v1-equivalent units.
sam: agree. UX: console should show both numbers side-by-side and a hover explaining the mapping formula. also add a time-series tag so alerts can be split by compat mapping.
julia: rollout plan? do we want gateway rewrite live immediately or feature-flagged and shadowed first?
kevin: propose feature-flagged rollout: start with shadowing (no rewrite) but add `X-Compat-Probe: v1->v2` header whenever fallthrough happens. after 24h of sampling we enable rewrite behind FF and start with 1% traffic rewrite, ramp to 50% over 48h.
mira: timeline + telemetry: 1) enable probe header and dashboard tile (metric: `compat.fallback.count` with label `map=v1->v2`) — owner @kevin — by EOD. 2) console change to show mapped quota — owner @sam — by EOW. 3) gateway rewrite FF — owner @kevin — start shadow 1% tomorrow. 4) audit billing delta in sandbox account — owner @ops — asap.
infra-bot: deploy triggered: `edge-config/compat-probe:feature-flag` -> canary on us-west-2 (sha: b3f2c9)
ops: I'll run cost diffs once probe data shows up. can we also add a regression alert if mapped-quota > actual-quota * 1.2 for any tenant?
alex: yes add alert: `compat.mapped_quota_delta` > 20% for 5m. pager to infra-oncall.
sam: console mock attached: https://figma.com/s/jk3r23 (mock shows side-by-side numbers and a tooltip).
julia: one more: telemetry retention — we should tag events with `compat_map` and keep at least 90d for audit.
kevin: acknowledged. I'll add tag `compat_map=v1->v2` and `compat_mode=rewritten|probed` and forward to long-term store.
mira: perfect. last ask: docs/email to customers explaining "minor billing artifacts while we map older clients" — can product draft?
julia: on it. will send a short note and helpdesk snippet.
kevin: starting probe rollout now. will post updates in this thread.
mira: thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: probe live in canary, seeing fallthrough samples already. first batch shows expected distribution (mostly `model=redwood-small`).
ops: cost sandbox diff queued, ETA 2h.
mira: closing loop later with numbers. for now keep FF gated until we confirm mapping behavior.
kevin: agree. will hold at 1% until we get signoff from ops/product.
